summary: Pinnacle West Capital Corporation filed an 8-K to report entry into an Equity Distribution Agreement for an at-the-market offering of common stock, with aggregate gross sales price up to $500 million. Multiple managers, forward sellers, and forward purchasers are involved, including BMO, Citigroup, Morgan Stanley, and others. Sales may be executed via ordinary brokers' transactions on NYSE, through market makers, or in privately negotiated transactions, at prevailing market prices. Managers receive a commission of up to 1% of gross sales. This is a routine capital-raising tool, not a special situation; no deal terms like fixed price or premium apply.
